To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present the first detailed study of Galactic sidelobe pickup in CMB experiments and find the level of contamination in the WMAP first year maps to be 1 μK or better in all bands.
we find the level of Galactic pickup to be 15, 0.7, 0.5, 0.1, and 0, and 1, 0.4, 0.2, 0.02, and 0 μK for K, Ka, and Q, V, W bands, respectively, and for intensity and polarized sky maps.
the sidelobe pickup in the first-year WMAP data is small, with rms levels of 15,2.1,2.0,0.3,0.5 μ K in the K, Ka,Q,V and W bands, and the polarized sidelobe pickup is 1 μ K or less.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the contamination due to sidelobe pickup of the WMAP CMB maps.
the level of Galactic contamination in the first-year CDM maps.
the contamination of CMB maps due to Galactic emission picked up by the WMAP radiometers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
WMAP is the first CMB mission that has been able to produce maps with sidelobe pickup contamination levels that are comparable to or below the noise levels of the maps themselves.
the WMAP sidelobe pickup is well understood, and that the WMAP maps are free of contamination from Galactic emission.
the sidelobes are not a significant source of contamination in the WMAP data, and are not a significant factor in the WMAP science results.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the WMAP first year data have a Galactic foreground contamination that is well below the expected level of CMB anisotropy.
the sidelobes of the WMAP radiometers have been well characterized and that the expected level of contamination has been quantified.
the WMAP first year maps are free from Galactic contamination at levels below 0.5% of the CMB fluctuations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sidelobe pickup is a significant contaminant for the WMAP K band maps.
WMAP's K band is significantly more contaminated than the other bands.
the level of contamination in the WMAP CMB maps from sidelobe pickup is negligible compared to other systematic effects, such as ground pickup and straylight.
